summary: Configured node1 as an NFSv4.2 server and mounted its shared export persistently on node2 and node3. Bidirectional file visibility, UID/GID 4200 ownership, permissions, and persistence through sequential OS reboots of all three nodes were verified.
actions_performed: Created sharedops with UID/GID 4200 on all nodes.
Exported the directory read-write to node2 and node3 over 10.100.222.0/24.
Mounted the export at /mnt/shared using persistent NFSv4.2 fstab entries on both clients.
Verified files created by either client were immediately visible from the other with ownership and modes preserved.
Restarted node2, node3, and node1 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and complete recovery.

evidence.summary: Shows node1/node2/node3 storage addresses 10.100.222.10, .11, and .12 on the shared /24.
Direct identity records show UID and GID 4200 on all three systems.

evidence.requirement: NFSv4 server, export, directory attributes, and persistent client mounts
evidence.summary: Shows active enabled server, client-restricted exports, directory mode 2770/ownership 4200:4200, persistent fstab entries, and live NFSv4.2 mounts.

evidence.requirement: Immediate bidirectional visibility with ownership and permissions retained
evidence.summary: node2's mode-640 file was read on node3 and node3's mode-660 file was read on node2; both remained sharedops:sharedops (4200:4200).
Captures healthy baseline, acknowledged safe reboot, boot-ID change from 3fad4432… to 23f49e39…, and recovered identity, NFSv4.2 mount, data, ownership, and modes.

evidence.summary: Captures healthy server baseline, acknowledged safe reboot, boot-ID change from 4d70780a… to 7c9dbc0d…, and recovered NFSv4 listener, exports, directory, identity, and data.

evidence.summary: Fresh post-restart files from both clients crossed immediately with modes 640/660 and UID/GID 4200; node1 remains active and exports all persisted data.
